ingestion.credential_channel: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_HEADERS runtime environment; no credential or environment placeholder in frozen Codex config
ingestion.tool_subprocess_policy: Codex shell subprocesses exclude OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_HEADERS and FLYWHEEL_LANGFUSE_AUTHORIZATION, with login-shell loading disabled
ingestion.propagation: session attribute must be present on every span
ingestion.attribute_encoding: langfuse.observation.type is lowercase; langfuse.observation.model.name is a string; langfuse.observation.usage_details and cost_details are JSON strings
ingestion.native_thread_attribute: conversation.id or thread.id remains native OTLP metadata and is not rewritten into artifact authorship

cloud-v2.pagination: follow meta.cursor until absent; enforce per-page limit and global startTime-descending order; reject changed query, repeated cursor, extra page, duplicate row, or incomplete chain
cloud-v2.population_rule: partition all session-filtered rows by exact work-order metadata; require one complete native trace per initial work order, one native Codex turn root, complete parent references, and no missing, unknown, or duplicate rows; join the provider-issued root to the work order's worker-attested primary artifact without manufacturing artifact spans

missing_rules.costDetails: absent or null is accepted as unavailable; never emit Langfuse price inference as subscription spend

self-hosted-v1.reason: Observations API v2 is Cloud-only; self-hosted readback varies by deployed version
